title: RS Legacy: Power Meets Versatility 🔥

history.fact: Introduced to the U.S. after a strong demand from enthusiasts for Audi’s RS models.

scenes.headline: High Performance
scenes.narration: Zero to sixty in 3.5 seconds. That’s the magic of the 2022 Audi RS6 Avant. Unleash your thrill-seeking side.

scenes.headline: The RS Legacy
scenes.narration: Since 2020, it’s been a staple for performance fans. Audi brought it stateside after enthusiasts clamored for RS models. Now, it’s making waves.

scenes.headline: 591 Horsepower
scenes.narration: Under the hood, a 4.0L twin-turbocharged V8 delivers 591 horsepower and 590 lb-ft of torque. Power at your fingertips. The engine's precision engineering ensures immediate throttle response.

scenes.headline: Dynamic Control
scenes.narration: Audi’s Quattro all-wheel-drive provides grip across every turn. It’s legendary in motorsport, and it’s yours on the road.

scenes.headline: Precision Fit
scenes.narration: Large 22-inch wheels wrapped in high-performance tires ensure a smooth ride. Every component is built for precision. These wheels weren't just chosen for looks; they improve handling, too.

scenes.headline: Value
scenes.narration: Originally priced around $120,000. Today, these wagons trade for about $130,000. Appreciate that stability.

scenes.headline: Your Pick
scenes.narration: Power and practicality merge seamlessly. So, is the RS6 your dream machine? Or does something else catch your eye?

sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2022 Audi RS6 Avant, finished in Nardo Gray with a black interior. The odometer currently displays approximately 400 miles. The attached Carfax history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this RS6’s brief past. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, factory equipment includes the Carbon Optic, Executive, Driver Assistance, and RS Design packages, as well as a sport exhaust, HD Matrix LED headlights, a sunroof, power-adjustable heated and ventilated front seats, a Bang & Olufsen premium sound system with 3D sound, and more as listed below. The seller reports no modifications. After an outcry from dedicated Audi enthusiasts, the manufacturer decided to bring the wagon version of its vaunted RS6 to the U.S. for the first time during the 2020 model year. It received nearly instant critical acclaim for its aggressive styling, everyday practicality, and outstanding performance. Power comes from a 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8 engine, rated at 591 horsepower and 590 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to all four wheels via an 8-speed automatic transmission and Audi’s Quattro all-wheel-drive system.
sections.Equipment: A window sticker is provided in the photo gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment includes: Carbon Optic Package (22-inch wheels, carbon fiber door mirror caps, carbon optic exterior trim) Executive Package (extended leather upholstery, rear heated seats, head-up display, power soft-closing doors) Driver Assistance Package (Adaptive Cruise Assist with Lane Guidance, Audi Side Assist with Pre Sense Rear, Intersection Assist, Traffic Sign Recognition) RS Design Package (black seat belts with gray edging, gray leather on the dash, armrests, console, RS floor mats with gray edging) Dynamic all-wheel steering Sport exhaust Red-painted brake calipers HD Matrix LED headlights Power-operated sunroof Carbon twill inlays Power-adjustable heated and ventilated front seats Audi Virtual Cockpit Plus digital instrument cluster Audi MMI Navigation Plus Bang & Olufsen Premium sound system with 3D sound 4-zone automatic climate control Surround View camera system Front and rear parking sensors
